 Follow ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ concert is coming to the Tacoma Dome
 Lexi Herda Sun, November 15, 2026 at 5:44 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Tacoma Dome This could be your 'golden' opportunity: " KPop Demon Hunters " is coming to Washington.
 HUNTR/X will take the stage at the Tacoma Dome on August 14 for two shows. The first will take place at 2 p.m. and the second will be at 7:30 p.m.
 The 'KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour' launches in June and will visit nearly 50 cities.
 "Powered by songs from Netflix's most popular film of all time, beloved animated HUNTR/X characters – Rumi, Mira and Zoey – will interact with the audience through cutting-edge performance innovations that bring this fan-favorite K-pop girl group to life like never before (yes, that also includes the animated characters of the Saja Boys and Derpy Tiger)," a news release states.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Creative direction for the tour is led by Amy Tinkham, a director, writer, and show designer with more than 25 years of experience across concerts, tours, theater, dance, and large-scale live entertainment. Her credits include Disney's Descendants/Zombies: Worlds Collide Tour, Cirque du Soleil's Songblazers, Aerosmith's Peace Out tour, Bob Marley Hope Road, and live productions for artists including James Taylor, Paul McCartney, and Mariah Carey.
 Tickets 
 Mastercard presale begins Wednesday, November 18 at 10 a.m. local time.
 Fan Presale begins Thursday, November 19 at 10 a.m. local time. Register now here .
 Tickets go on sale to the general public Friday, November 20 at 10 a.m. local time.
 Advertisement Advertisement A limited number of exclusive VIP experiences and packages will be available. These exclusive offers can include reserved seated tickets, on-stage photo opportunities, limited-edition memorabilia, preshow parties, custom merchandise and more. For more information, click here .
 About KPop Demon Hunters 
 The Netflix sensation was released in June of 2025. It is about a renowned KPop group that leads secret double lives as demon hunters.
 The movie sustained 63 consecutive weeks in Netflix's Global Top 10. The song 'Golden reached 2 billion Spotify streams and broke the all-time record for the longest running soundtrack at No. 1 on Billboard's Top Soundtracks chart, according to Marian Lee, Netflix's Chief Marketing Officer.
 "This fandom was never about a single moment, and the Golden World Tour is how we keep it going – bringing that 'Takedown' energy to arenas around the world, where fans can sing, dance and help HUNTR/X seal the Honmoon," Lee shared.
